answer: Every identity is pinned to a network origin (ASN plus subnet), woven into a trellis where each branch shares one fixed influence budget no matter how many accounts hang from it. A bond in the vault counts, but bonds on the same branch split one budget instead of stacking. Residential origins earn a full share; datacenter subnets get less. A thousand puppets on one server farm collapse into one branch worth one vote. To regain N votes the attacker's voyage must span N separate networks, paying retail infrastructure per branch — linear in N, no batch discount — while an honest user pays once.
